Enabled destination actions and Close remained contained, focusable and reachable. The portal source is unchanged in this review.

evidenceInspected: AGENTS.md, reviewer-field-ux persona, REVIEW_PROTOCOL, active D3 predicate, Product Specification §7.5, Scope §1, design rules R04/R05/R12/R18, and summary changelog. Directly inspected the frozen C6 reference and relevant current image captures.

The application diff changes four class strings only: wrapper/status width containment and wrapping on Copy/Share controls. Text, font classes, minimum target heights, status lifetime, live-region semantics and handlers remain unchanged. The production component blob exactly matches the passing diagnostic candidate.
Read all prior round verdicts, blockers and findings. This round restricts its investigation to the copy/status containment correction and regressions caused by it.

Mac diagnostic run 38631356366, commit 7af26c144311f0423aaeb7d95c2efe97d8045c71: inspected image-comparison-report.json in the d3-copy-status artifact. Eight original image cases passed, one original WebKit case was skipped, and there were zero unexpected or flaky results. Renderer, masks and comparison limits remained unchanged.

Mac WebKit 320px/200% image differences were mean 0.404909/share 0.003274/colour 0.421125 for double names; 0.357851/0.002715/0.375857 for hostile crews; and 0.393306/0.003723/0.396433 for hostile duties. All remain below unchanged limits of 2.5/0.012/2.5. Inspected generated crew/duty PNGs and corresponding comparison captures.

Identified a durable-test coverage gap: a shorter Copia non riuscita status could satisfy the initial containment checks. The exact canonical copied-message assertion now closes that gap. Its first rerun reproduced missing Chromium clipboard permission; the failure is preserved in the scratch report cvc-d3-status-missing-permission-failure.json and test-results/d3-summary-controls-review. Setup now grants Chromium the same clipboard permissions used by existing summary tests, without replacing rendering or clipboard code.

Inspected the final test-results/e2e-report.json: three projects passed, with zero skips, retries, unexpected results or flakes; total duration 48.852 seconds. Pixel 7 Chromium, iPhone Chromium viewport and iPhone WebKit all exercised the exact long copied message.

Final recorded bounds agree across all three projects at 320×664/200% text: wrapper x32–288/y209–632; status x32–288/y209–513; Share x60–260/y405–493; Copy x32–288/y529–632. Share is 88px high, Copy is 103px high, and the status-to-Copy gap is 16px. Both button centres receive their own targets. Share accepts focus, the actual Share-button click reaches the synthetic native-share handler, and the status clears afterwards.

Directly inspected all three final unmasked copy-status.png captures under test-results/d3-summary-controls-final. The copied message and both button captions remain readable within their surfaces; no native-share control escapes the wrapper or viewport.

Bounded pier routine: 1) Open the chosen session’s read view: one tap. 2) Copy its image: one tap. 3) Optionally tap Condividi: one tap. The fix introduces no additional action. Overall task time and physical reading effort were not measured.

lenses: Restricted native-share/status containment at 320px and 200% text.
Regressions in target height, spacing, readable captions, focus and pointer reachability.
Preservation of the original summary-image renderer, exclusion masks and fidelity limits.
